title: Force on a gate from the pressure triangle
caption: Pressure on the gate grows from 0 at the surface to 29.4 kPa at 3 m. The area under the line, 44.1 kN per metre of width, times the 2 m width is the total force 88.2 kN: the same as ρg h_c A with the centroid depth 1.5 m. It acts at the triangle's centroid, 2/3 of the way down (2 m).
alt: Graph of water pressure in kilopascals against depth from 0 to 3 metres, a straight line to 29.4 kilopascals, with the triangle underneath shaded; its area is 44.1 kilonewtons per metre.
description: The horizontal axis is depth in m; the vertical axis is gauge pressure ρgh in kPa.
The line p = 9.8h kPa reaches 29.4 kPa at 3 m.
The shaded triangle has area ½ × 3 × 29.4 = 44.1 kN per metre of gate width.
Times the width 2 m: F = 88.2 kN (the lesson's 88 kN), acting at depth 2/3 × 3 = 2 m.
